marketing-display.purpose: Public www marketing only; operational UI retains its own scale.

marketing-display-mobile.purpose: Widths through 399px; inherits weight 650 and line height 1.05 from the hero.

marketing-headline.purpose: Explanatory marketing sections, never operational dashboards or checkout.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal elevation; marketing sections remain flat.

motion.name: control-fast
motion.purpose: Existing primary and secondary button color transitions.

motion.name: welcome-expand
motion.purpose: Source .welcome-main-photo: clip-path inset(0 6% round 32px) to inset(0 0 round 32px); only supported browsers from 800px with no reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: chapter-stack
motion.purpose: Source .menu-chapter: native sticky panels, static through 799px width, through 650px viewport height, and with reduced motion. All content visible by default.

motion.name: logo-drift
motion.purpose: Six localized generic venue placeholders under an invitation, never actual customer references or guaranteed advertising. Pause/resume control and hover pause the track; reduced motion shows all six in a static grid, hiding the duplicate list and pause control. Duplicated content is aria-hidden.

components.name: Marketing primary action
components.description: One dominant registration or task action.
components.html: Betrieb einrichten
components.css: .ds-control { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:56px; padding:14px 24px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; font:600 19px/1.25 "Lexend", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms,border-color 120ms; } .ds-primary { background:var(--zk-action, #000); color:var(--zk-action-fg, #fff); } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--zk-neutral-900, #171717); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-control { transition:none; } }

components.name: Marketing secondary action
components.description: Secondary controls such as the header login pill and mobile navigation.
components.html: Anmelden
components.css: .ds-control { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; font:600 17px/1.25 "Lexend", Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms,border-color 120ms; } .ds-secondary { background:var(--zk-surface, #fff); color:var(--zk-text, #000); border-color:var(--zk-border-strong, #d4d4d4); } .ds-secondary:hover { background:var(--zk-surface-muted, #fafafa); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-control { transition:none; } }

components.name: Product image placeholder
components.description: Text-only future capture inside a black 6px smartphone frame; the full-width staff variant uses the same border, a muted surface and a 16:9 preferred ratio. No fabricated product UI.
components.css: .ds-placeholder { margin:0; display:grid; align-content:center; justify-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:24px; width:min(100%,280px); aspect-ratio:9/18; padding:32px 20px; border:6px solid var(--zk-text, #000); border-radius:40px; background:var(--zk-page, #fff); color:var(--zk-text, #000); text-align:center; font-family:"Lexend", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-placeholder p { margin:0; font-size:24px; line-height:1.25; max-width:24ch; font-weight:500; } .ds-placeholder figcaption { font-size:14px; font-weight:500; } .ds-placeholder.staff { width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; min-height:auto; border-radius:24px; background:var(--zk-surface-muted, #fafafa); }

components.name: Public navigation link
components.description: Visible text navigation with an underline on hover and a distinct keyboard outline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; font-family:"Lexend", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:var(--zk-text, #000); padding:12px 0; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Inline explanatory link
components.description: A secondary text destination within explanatory content.
components.css: .ds-inline-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:12px 0; font:600 16px/1.5 "Lexend", Arial, sans-serif; color:var(--zk-link, #000); text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-inline-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Footer text link
components.description: Section links and the privacy-settings action underline on hover. Other-page links show a persistent arrow and no hover underline; external hosts open a new tab with an accessible notice.
components.css: .ds-footer-link { display:inline-block; padding-block:12px; font:400 14px/1.5 "Lexend", Arial, sans-serif; color:var(--zk-text, #000); text-decoration:none; } .ds-footer-link:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-footer-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--zk-focus, #000); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: Zackisch adds optional browser-based QR ordering and payments to existing hospitality workflows. Table service and counter pickup are both supported. The restaurant keeps its POS and service choices; guests do not need an app/account.
keyCharacteristics: Unchanged black wordmark and signet; only the public footer wordmark uses owner-authorized CSS opacity 0.22.

rules.name: The Marketing Scope Rule
rules.body: Larger display typography belongs to the public website's explanatory hierarchy; keep the operational UI scale unchanged. Headings wrap naturally, without fixed-height text containers. Body copy retains a maximum 65-character measure where the layout permits; long legal text uses a narrower 760px article container. Test the actual translation at 320px and with enlarged text.

rules.name: The Visible Motion Rule
rules.body: Scroll enhancements begin from visible content. On the public website, desktop-only photo clipping is progressive enhancement; reduced-motion mode disables animations, transitions and sticky chapter panels. No content depends on animation support or scroll position to become readable.

rules.name: The Footer Logo Exception Rule
rules.body: Only the public footer presents the unchanged original black wordmark at CSS opacity 0.22 on Electric Citron, with 16px side margins and 8px bottom padding. Other logo placements remain opaque black.

dos: Use real color stock photographs with verified free commercial rights; no optional attribution captions. Keep provenance.
Keep product image areas clearly text-labelled until actual screenshots are available.

Header country trigger matches the login secondary pill and forms a 12px-gap group with it with 48px minimum height and 17px text; footer country, help and research triggers use transparent Citron outline pills. Label venue placeholder band with Hier könnte dein Betrieb auftauchen / Your venue could be here
Left-align the personal contact block with a bottom separator and no top border; email uses no arrow and underlines on hover or keyboard focus.

Footer: two columns on desktop and centered single column below 800px, country trigger first above unheaded navigation ordered outlined help, outlined research, features, pricing, questions, contact, then legal. Contact scrolls to the homepage email section with a clean URL.
donts: Never recolor or recreate the supplied logo artwork.
Never invent screenshots, endorsements or commercial claims.
Do not use em or en dashes as sentence punctuation in authored copy.
